Chapter 3 — Create

Build a small IFC4 file in memory and dump it as STEP text. newGuid() in app.js compresses a UUID into an IFC GlobalId. This package does not export that helper.

Starting…

1. Create an empty file

await runtime.loadPlugin('schema', 'ifc4');
const model = new ifcopenshell.File('IFC4');
Waiting…

2. Create entities

const project = model.createEntity('IfcProject', {
  GlobalId: newGuid(),
  Name: 'Tutorial project',
});
const wall = model.createEntity('IfcWall', {
  GlobalId: newGuid(),
  Name: 'Tutorial wall',
});
Waiting…

3. Read what you created

console.log(project.id(), wall.Name);
console.log(model.byType('IfcWall').length);
Waiting…

4. Export STEP text

console.log(model.toString());
model.dispose();
Waiting…
